tasteMarketingPageGate.applicability: This route is a functional reference catalog. The marketing-page checker treats its toolbar and 87 item cards as landing-page sections. Its fixes require a full-screen hero/footer, unique layouts for catalog entries, and every card title on the global left edge. Those prescriptions conflict with the compact selection workflow and correctly aligned reusable card grid. Findings are retained without hiding content, altering the checker, or declaring a pass.
examples: 88 edge-left findings include card titles intentionally inset within three grid columns.
60 flush findings treat item actions and toolbar alignment as marketing section boundaries.
